result.rule: When the description states that a receiving party must confirm receipt of an item that another party submitted to it and must also evaluate that item, as mandatory actions of the receiving party: Model the receiving party's confirmation and evaluation as separate user tasks in that party's lane, placed after the submitting task and before any decision that depends on the evaluation. Do not model the receipt as a new start event, and do not replace the evaluation with a gateway or a flow that has no task.

When the description says an external party (such as a customer) has provided information, and the producer then performs a distinct step that works on that information (for example determining, specifying or preparing items from it): Model the arrival of the information as an event (a message start event or an intermediate catch event, as the description implies), and keep the producer's subsequent step as its own activity placed after that event. Use a userTask or manualTask according to whether the description states software support. Do not let the receipt event replace the step that works on the information.

When The description states that a party performs an action of its own (for example, a customer giving feedback after a case is closed) and names no message, timer, or condition that the process waits for.: Model that stated action as a task that represents the performed work, placed in the order the description gives. Do not model it as an intermediate catch event, because a catch event represents an occurrence the process waits for. Use a catch event only when the description says the process waits for an external occurrence.

When the description states that a system generates an artifact and that this artifact is delivered to a party through one or more channels, and a later clause makes further messages to that party optional or conditional: Model a send task for the delivery step directly after the generating task, in the order the description gives, and continue the main sequence from that send task. Place any exclusive gateway that decides on further messages to the same party after the delivery task, not before it. Give each optional follow-up message its own send task on a labeled branch of that gateway, and let the delivery task remain on the path that all cases share.
